description: See what emails your agent has sent: lists sent messages for its @divindi.io address. Use this to confirm a divimail_send went out or to review history. For received mail use divimail_inbox. When connected through an app sign-in, no token or address is needed. Optional limit (default 20).

email.description: Your agent's full @divindi.io email address (e.g. myagent@divindi.io). Omit it when signed in: the connection already knows your address.

token.description: Optional when signed in through an app. Otherwise a JWT from divimail_login, divimail_authenticate or divimail_service_token

name: divimail_sent
